mapper.select: SELECT ID, ARTICLE_ID, VERSION, PUBLISH_TIME, STATUS, RETRY_COUNT, ERROR_MSG, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, EXECUTE_TIME, FINISH_TIME FROM article_auto_publish_timing WHERE ARTICLE_ID = #{articleId} AND STATUS = -1

SELECT ID, ARTICLE_ID, VERSION, PUBLISH_TIME, STATUS, RETRY_COUNT, ERROR_MSG, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, EXECUTE_TIME, FINISH_TIME FROM article_auto_publish_timing WHERE ARTICLE_ID = #{articleId} AND STATUS = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE article_auto_publish_timing SET STATUS = 4, ERROR_MSG = #{remark}, UPDATE_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ARTICLE_ID = #{articleId} AND STATUS IN (-1, 0)
UPDATE article_auto_publish_timing SET STATUS = 0, UPDATE_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ARTICLE_ID = #{articleId} AND STATUS = -1
UPDATE article_auto_publish_timing SET STATUS = 4, ERROR_MSG = #{remark}, UPDATE_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ARTICLE_ID = #{articleId} AND STATUS = -1
